a=gc.mem_free()
t=time.monotonic()
import foxlib

import gc
try:
 fox.deinit()
except Exception:
 pass
from foxlib.netfox import NetFox
fox = NetFox('fox.json', defaults='defaults.json', quiet=True)
if fox.fatal: raise RuntimeError('fox not usable: ' + fox.fatal)
gc.collect()
print(gc.mem_free())
print(fox.radio.status)
print(fox.rssi())
print(fox.radio.mac())
